notes: ACCOUNT POSITION. Contract value QAR 73,500.00 under work order WO/1A/096/26. Received to date QAR 67,125.00 — the 35% advance of QAR 25,725.00 on 01-10-2026 (RCT-274/2026); QAR 29,400.00 on 19-10-2026 settling INV-275/2026 in full (RCT-312/2026); and QAR 12,000.00 by this receipt. BALANCE OUTSTANDING QAR 6,375.00.

HOW THIS PAYMENT IS APPLIED. INV-275/2026 of QAR 29,400.00 was settled in full on 19-10-2026 and is receipted under RCT-312/2026. This payment of QAR 12,000.00 is therefore applied to our final invoice INV-300/2026 of QAR 18,375.00, which stands at QAR 6,375.00.

THE CONTRACT IS INVOICED IN FULL AND NO FURTHER INVOICE WILL FOLLOW. Settlement of the QAR 6,375.00 remaining on INV-300/2026 closes the account between us. Kindly quote invoice INV-300/2026 and your work order WO/1A/096/26 as the references on the remittance.

Received with thanks. Please note that this receipt is issued together with RCT-312/2026, which records your payment of 19-10-2026 and corrects our earlier statements that INV-275/2026 remained outstanding.

WARRANTY: twelve (12) months on the cold room panels, the doors and our workmanship from the date of handover, and twelve (12) months on the compressors, coils, electrical components and controls from the date of commissioning. Excludes damage from misuse, power surge, improper voltage, water ingress, unauthorised modification or the absence of routine maintenance.
This receipt is issued against INV-300/2026 and is subject to the terms of work order WO/1A/096/26.
